answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Registered jeweller shop licence with jewellery trade verification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 15 minutes once; the operator of 654 fakes spends 9810 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Hold the grove up to the light, weigh the bridge of the attack, and keep the forge of the verdict where everyone can audit it. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
